list.doc: List tasks scoped to a folder node, ordered by Kanban column then rank. Returns all statuses for that folder.

nid.doc: Folder node id to scope to. Absent/null returns legacy unscoped (nid IS NULL) tasks.

include_unscoped.doc: When 1 (workspace-root view), also include legacy tasks with no folder (nid IS NULL).

returns.doc: Array of task objects ordered by status column then rank

description.doc: Task description (long text), null if not set

status.doc: Kanban column: todo | in_progress | to_review | complete

due_date.doc: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD), null if not set

created_by.doc: UID of the user who created the task

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

nid.doc: Folder node id the task belongs to, null if workspace-level (legacy)

assignee_uids.doc: Comma-separated list of assignee UIDs, null if unassigned

label_ids.doc: Comma-separated list of label IDs attached to the task, null if none

parent_task_id.doc: Id of the parent task when this row is a subtask, null otherwise.

subtask_total.doc: Number of subtasks under this task (0 for a subtask, which cannot have children).

subtask_done.doc: How many of those subtasks sit in a column flagged is_done. Drives the done/total badge; computed server-side so client filters cannot skew it.

create.doc: Create a new task scoped to a folder node. The task is placed at the bottom of the target status column within that folder. reporter_uid defaults to the caller when omitted.

status.doc: Initial Kanban column: a built-in key (todo | in_progress | to_review | complete) or a custom task_column id. Defaults to todo.

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter (who the task is reported by). Exactly one user; omit to keep the existing value. On create, omitting it defaults the reporter to the caller. Never clears: a task always reads as reported by somebody, falling back to created_by.

due_date.doc: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional.

nid.doc: Folder node id the task belongs to. Absent/null = workspace-level.

assignee_uids.doc: UIDs of the users to assign. Optional. Each must be a valid drumate.

assignee_uid.doc: Deprecated single-assignee form (use assignee_uids). Still accepted.

mention_uids.doc: UIDs @-mentioned in the description. Server notifies each (excluding self).

parent_task_id.doc: Id of the task this one is a subtask of. Absent/null = a normal top-level task. The parent must exist and must not itself be a subtask (one level of nesting only). The new task inherits the PARENT's nid, so any nid sent alongside this is ignored.

returns.doc: Newly created task object

errors.message: assignee_uid does not reference a valid user
reporter_uid must be an existing user
parent_task_id does not reference an existing task
cannot add a subtask to a task that is itself a subtask

update.doc: Update a task's title, description, priority, due date and/or reporter. Title / description / priority / reporter_uid: omit to keep existing value. due_date is always written through (pass null to clear). created_by is NOT updatable — it is write-once provenance; reporter_uid is the editable field.

title.doc: New task title. Omit to keep existing value.

description.doc: New task description. Omit to keep existing value; pass empty string to clear.

priority.doc: New priority. Omit to keep existing value.

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter (who the task is reported by). Exactly one user; omit to keep the existing value. On create, omitting it defaults the reporter to the caller. Never clears: a task always reads as reported by somebody, falling back to created_by.

due_date.doc: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Pass null to clear.

mention_uids.doc: UIDs newly @-mentioned in this edit. Server notifies each (excluding self).

returns.doc: Updated task object

errors.message: No task found with the given ID
priority must be one of: low, medium, high, urgent
reporter_uid must be an existing user

update_status.doc: Move a task to a different Kanban column. The task is placed at the bottom of the destination column. When the moved task is a subtask and this move leaves every sibling in a done column, the PARENT is auto-completed and returned as `parent` on the response.

status.doc: Destination Kanban column: a built-in key (todo | in_progress | to_review | complete) or a custom task_column id

returns.doc: Updated task object with new status and rank. Carries an extra `parent` key holding the parent's updated row when a subtask rollup auto-completed it; absent otherwise.

errors.message: No task found with the given ID
status is neither a built-in column nor an existing custom column id

update_assignee.doc: Replace a task's assignee set (multi-assignee). Pass the full new set in assignee_uids; an empty array clears all assignees.

assignee_uids.doc: Full new set of assignee UIDs. [] clears all. Each must be a valid drumate.

assignee_uid.doc: Deprecated single-assignee form (use assignee_uids). Still accepted; null unassigns.

returns.doc: Updated task object

errors.message: No task found with the given ID
assignee_uid does not reference a valid user

delete.doc: Delete a task permanently, together with any subtasks. All linked file and label associations are removed.

returns.doc: Deleted task ID, affected row count (the task PLUS its cascaded subtasks) and the ids of those subtasks.

affected.doc: Number of rows deleted (1 if found, 0 if not found)

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

subtask_ids.doc: Ids of the subtasks removed with the parent, so callers can prune them locally. Empty when it had none.

link_file.doc: Link a file (media node) to a task. Idempotent — linking the same file twice has no effect. Returns the full updated list of files linked to the task.

task_id.doc: Task ID to link the file to

file_nid.doc: Media node ID of the file to link

returns.doc: Updated list of all files linked to the task, including media metadata

linked_by.doc: UID of the user who linked the file

ctime.doc: Unix timestamp of when the file was linked

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

unlink_file.doc: Remove the link between a file and a task. The file itself is not deleted from the hub.

task_id.doc: Task ID to unlink the file from

file_nid.doc: Media node ID of the file to unlink

returns.doc: Confirmation of the unlinked pair

affected.doc: 1 if removed, 0 if link did not exist

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

get_linked_files.doc: Get all files linked to a task, including file metadata from the media table.

task_id.doc: Task ID to get linked files for

returns.doc: List of linked file objects with media metadata

link_label.doc: Attach a label to a task. Idempotent — linking the same label twice has no effect. Returns the updated list of labels on the task.

returns.doc: Updated list of labels attached to the task

ctime.doc: Unix timestamp of when the label was linked

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

unlink_label.doc: Remove a label from a task. The label itself is not deleted from the hub.

returns.doc: Confirmation of the unlinked pair

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

get_labels.doc: Get all labels attached to a task.

returns.doc: List of labels attached to the task

search_files.doc: Search media files in the current hub that can be linked to a task. Results are filtered by the caller's read-permission. If task_id is provided, files already linked to that task are excluded.

task_id.doc: Exclude files already linked to this task

returns.doc: Array of media items matching the search pattern

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

comment_list.doc: List a task's comments (flat, chronological). Author name/avatar is resolved client-side from the hub member list.

task_id.doc: Task ID to list comments for

returns.doc: Comments ordered by ctime ASC

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

comment_create.doc: Add a comment to a task. @-mentioned members are notified.

parent_id.doc: Root comment id when this is a reply; omit/null for a top-level comment

reply_to_uid.doc: Author of the comment this reply answers, when it is a child comment. Notified as a reply, not a mention.

mention_uids.doc: UIDs @-mentioned in the body. Server notifies each (excluding self).

returns.doc: The created comment row

comment_react.doc: Toggle the caller's emoji reaction on a comment (add if absent, remove if present).

task_id.doc: Parent task ID (so the broadcast targets the right feed)

returns.doc: Toggled reaction summary

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

comment_link_file.doc: Attach a file (media node) to your own comment, as opposed to link_file which attaches it to the task. Idempotent — linking the same file twice has no effect. Returns the comment's full attachment list.

comment_id.doc: Comment ID to attach the file to. Must be the caller's own comment.

file_nid.doc: Media node ID of the file

task_id.doc: Task the comment belongs to — the change is broadcast to that task's feed

returns.doc: The comment's attachments, including media metadata

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

errors.message: No comment with that ID owned by the caller

comment_unlink_file.doc: Detach a file from your own comment. The media node itself is left in place. Author-only.

comment_id.doc: Comment ID to detach the file from. Must be the caller's own comment.

file_nid.doc: Media node ID of the file

task_id.doc: Task the comment belongs to — the change is broadcast to that task's feed

returns.doc: { comment_id, file_nid, task_id, affected } — affected is 0 when nothing matched

errors.message: No comment with that ID owned by the caller

comment_update.doc: Edit your own comment. Returns COMMENT_NOT_FOUND if the caller is not the author.

body.doc: New comment body in marker form

mention_uids.doc: UIDs @-mentioned in the body. Server notifies each (excluding self).

returns.doc: The updated comment row

errors.message: No comment with that ID owned by the caller

task_id.doc: Parent task ID (so the broadcast targets the right feed)

returns.doc: Deleted comment ID and affected row count

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

activity.doc: Recent task activity for a folder scope (Project Health feed): create / update / status / complete / assignee / link_file / comment events, newest first.

nid.doc: Folder node id to scope to (mirrors task.list)

include_unscoped.doc: When 1, also include legacy nid-less rows (workspace root)

returns.doc: Activity rows (task_id, actor_uid, action, meta, ctime, plus live task title/priority/status when the task still exists)

column_list.doc: List the custom Kanban columns for a folder scope. Built-in columns (todo / in_progress / to_review / complete) are implicit client-side and never stored.

nid.doc: Folder node id to scope to (mirrors task.list)

returns.doc: Custom column rows in board order

id.doc: Column id — doubles as the task.status key for its tasks

nid.doc: Folder node id, null at workspace root

theme.doc: Palette theme: default | orange | yellow | green | cyan | blue | purple | pink | red

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

column_create.doc: Create a custom Kanban column for a folder scope.

theme.doc: Palette theme key; invalid values fall back to default

nid.doc: Folder node id the column belongs to

returns.doc: The created column row

errors.message: insert returned no row — hub DB likely missing the task_column migration

column_update.doc: Rename and/or re-theme a column on one board. Omit a field to keep it.

nid.doc: Folder scope the column belongs to. Built-in ids are stored once per folder, so without it the rename would hit every board

returns.doc: The updated column row

column_delete.doc: Delete a column from one board. Its tasks are re-homed onto the first surviving column of that same board (never lost).

nid.doc: Folder scope the column belongs to. Built-in ids are stored once per folder, so without it the delete would hit every board

returns.doc: Deletion summary

moved_tasks.doc: How many tasks were moved back to todo

reporter_uid.doc: UID of the reporter. Editable, unlike created_by; falls back to created_by for tasks predating the reporter field.

column_reorder.doc: Persist a drag-reorder of the custom columns. Sets each column's position to its index in the supplied order. Scoped to the folder node.

order.doc: Comma-separated custom column ids in their new left-to-right order

nid.doc: Folder node id the columns belong to. Defaults to workspace root.

returns.doc: The custom column rows in their new board order

column_watch_list.doc: List the column keys the caller is subscribed to (bell on) within a folder scope, so the board can render each column's bell state.

nid.doc: Folder node id to scope to (mirrors task.list). Defaults to workspace root.

returns.doc: Array of watched column keys (built-in status strings or custom column ids)

column_watch_set.doc: Subscribe the caller to change-notifications for a column. Idempotent.

column_key.doc: Built-in status string (todo | in_progress | to_review | complete) or a custom column id

nid.doc: Folder node id the column belongs to. Defaults to workspace root.

returns.doc: { nid, column_key, watching: 1 }

column_watch_unset.doc: Unsubscribe the caller from a column's change-notifications.

column_key.doc: Built-in status string or custom column id

nid.doc: Folder node id the column belongs to. Defaults to workspace root.

returns.doc: { nid, column_key, watching: 0 }
